owner_directive: 明显能慢慢 tp，大趋势不要机械止盈，也不要把止盈伪装成抬止损
approved_bundle: Owner authorized autonomous exploration. V6 protected reversals but sold tails early; V7 preserved tails but released too late. V8 banks the first two earned stages immediately and defers the last two until EMA30 weakness.

frozen_entry.contract: Exact V5 K1/K2 morphology and one-signal-per-live-regime ledger.

frozen_execution.same_bar_priority: active stop before a newly touched immediate milestone
frozen_execution.gap_stop_fill: bar open when it gaps beyond the active stop
frozen_execution.state_update_timing: EMA weakness and SMA trail calculated at close t become actionable on t+1

hybrid_harvest.immediate_fill: exact +2/+4 signal ATR target after the active stop survives the bar
hybrid_harvest.deferred_release_condition: after +8/+12 ATR earns a deferred slot, a completed adverse-side EMA30 close while net-profitable schedules at most one slot
hybrid_harvest.deferred_fill: next bar open; if the open gaps through the active stop, stop has priority
hybrid_harvest.remainder: unchanged SMA60 minus direction times one current ATR runner

selection.rank: Among arms meeting every gate, maximize robust half-year net bp and then preserve more runner. If none pass, retain the baseline and report failure.
selection.audit_rule: Audit only the development-selected stage fraction when every gate passes.
